notes.title: New Uncensored Release - Yuri Visual Novel, Forest Guardian!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12668505/98ca23738fb545bc6ba53290456631cb03427e99.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

This is a quick update, just dropping in to let everyone know we've rolled out a new release, a fantasy yuri visual novel entitled "Forest Guardian". It's [b]completely uncensored[/b] and features around 5~ hours of gameplay and around 20 CGs. It also features foxgirls! It runs at $10.99, but will have a 10% discount for the next week.

Pick it up here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1181030/Forest_Guardian

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Chinese Translation + Mature Content
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As of 1/29/19, Reine Works has added another patch (1.3) to the game.

Here's the changelog:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese translation added - Switch between English and Chinese on the main menu
    [*] 1 English typo fixed
    [*] A minor bug within Isolde's route was fixed
   [*]  Ending/credits sequence was redone - New ending theme added
    [*] The content patch was updated with various typo fixes
[/list]

We've also added the mature content patch those over the age of 18 courtesy of Reine Works. It's free and can be downloaded from here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1023670/The_Wilting_Amaranth__Mature_Content/
    
----------

The Wilting Amaranth（花朵永不凋零）是一款简短的百合向游戏。故事以民
间传说为蓝本。其中包含2条角色分支，13个结局和3到5小时的游戏流程。

三个女人一台戏。在恶名昭彰的女巫塔内，她们被命运的红绳紧缚着，走尽
百转千层。她们各自有各自的不幸，她们饱含爱意却不可倾诉——展露出真
实的自我，透露出对同性的喜爱，会遭到人们的唾弃。面对如此现状，唯有
苦苦挣扎。

与社会主流的爱情观背道而驰，真的会迎来圆满结局吗？

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - 9/19/18
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've updated TWA to version 1.2.
As we're told by Reine Works, this is more or less a collection of many small fixes and a few quality of life tweaks/improvements.

Change log:

[list]
    [*]Simple opening video added
    [*]Clarification added to the "enter your nickname" section
   [*]Misc. typos have been corrected
    [*]Some passages have had minor changes for clarity and/or flow
    [*]Some old sound effects have been replaced
    [*]Many new sound effects have been added
   [*] A number of minor animations have been added
    [*]Some basic visual changes, fixes, and additions for Priya & Isolde's routes (mostly the latter)
[/list]

If you had the uncensor patch previously downloaded, you may need to redownload it - you can find a link on the game's page on our site; http://tophat.studio.
